description: Reads one listed branch and the other listed branches of its brand. Identify it by the three slugs a search result carries: tenantSlug, brandSlug and branchSlug. Orders are not placed here: every result carries an orderUrl, the restaurant's own page, where the person places the order.

branch_slug.description: The branchSlug of the search result.

brand_slug.description: The brandSlug of the search result.

latitude.description: Optional position, to get distances and whether the branch delivers there.

longitude.description: Optional position; give it together with latitude.

tenant_slug.description: The tenantSlug of the search result.

name: get_restaurant
title: Get a restaurant branch
